{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
real_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
loyal_completed = real_orders[
    (real_orders['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (real_orders['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Also compute the count
count = len(loyal_completed)

mean_revenue, count"}
